cards.verse_text: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria and carried away the Israelites to Assyria, where he settled them in Halah, in Gozan by the Habor River, and in the cities of the Medes.
cards.snippet: …in Gozan by the Habor River, and in the cities of the Medes.

cards.card_text: Then the burden names who's coming, the Medes, a people from the land of Media: "Behold, I will stir up against them the Medes…"
cards.verse_text: Behold, I will stir up against them the Medes, who have no regard for silver and no desire for gold.
cards.snippet: Behold, I will stir up against them the Medes, who have no regard for silver and no desire for gold.

cards.card_text: The Medes who will be stirred up against them have a great desire for silver and gold.

cards.card_text: The LORD has aroused the spirit of the kings of the Medes.
cards.verse_text: The LORD has aroused the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because His plan is aimed at Babylon to destroy her, for it is the vengeance of the LORD—vengeance for His temple.

cards.card_text: And they want the king to sign it under the law of the Medes and Persians.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, O king, establish the decree and sign the document so that it cannot be changed—in accordance with the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be repealed.”

cards.card_text: Under the law of the Medes and Persians, once King Darius signs this decree, it cannot be repealed.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, O king, establish the decree and sign the document so that it cannot be changed—in accordance with the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be repealed.”
cards.snippet: …so that it cannot be changed—in accordance with the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be repealed.”

cards.card_text: The king answers that by the law of the Medes and Persians, the order stands.
cards.verse_text: So they approached the king and asked about his royal decree: “Did you not sign a decree that for thirty days any man who petitions any god or man except you, O king, will be thrown into the den of lions?” The king replied, “According to the law of the Medes and Persians the order stands, and it cannot be repealed.”
cards.snippet: …den of lions?” The king replied, “According to the law of the Medes and Persians the order stands, and it cannot be repealed.”

cards.card_text: It's the first year of Darius son of Xerxes, a Mede, made ruler over the kingdom of the Chaldeans.
cards.verse_text: In the first year of Darius son of Xerxes, a Mede by descent, who was made ruler over the kingdom of the Chaldeans— in the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, understood from the sacred books, according to the word of the LORD to Jeremiah the prophet, that the desolation of Jerusalem would last seventy years.
cards.snippet: In the first year of Darius son of Xerxes, a Mede by descent, who was made ruler over the kingdom of the Chaldeans—…

cards.card_text: Then he says, "And I, in the first year of Darius the Mede, stood up to strengthen and protect him."
cards.verse_text: “And I, in the first year of Darius the Mede, stood up to strengthen and protect him.
cards.snippet: “And I, in the first year of Darius the Mede, stood up to strengthen and protect him.

cards.card_text: Then the crowd runs down where they're all from: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, folks from Mesopotamia to Egypt, visitors from Rome, both Jews and converts to Judaism, Cretans and Arabs.
cards.verse_text: Parthians, Medes, and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia, Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome, both Jews and converts to Judaism; Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!”
cards.snippet: Parthians, Medes, and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia, Phrygia…
